auto_update_off: Dates, locations and abbreviations from the catalog stay as they are on this device.
auto_update_on: Dates, locations and abbreviations from the catalog are kept up to date. Timetables never update by themselves.
catalog_error_fetch: Could not download {file} from the catalog.
export_invalid: The end lies before the start.
export_text: No global dates file is loaded, so choose the period to export. Classes are expanded week by week, one calendar entry per date.
footer_note: Client-only. All data stays in your browser.
grid_empty: Add a timetable to your profile to see it here.
groups_export_link_long: The selection is too long for a link. Download the profile file instead.
import_error: Not a valid share link or profile file.
import_offline_warning: Some timetables are missing on this device. They may be available online once you are back on the network.
import_text: Paste a share link or choose a profile file. The import always creates a new profile.
picker_add_text: Choose the timetables to copy into this profile. Copies are yours: an update is only ever applied when you ask for it.
picker_new_text: Choose the timetables the new profile starts with. It gets its own copy of each one.
picker_none: No timetables to choose from yet. Upload one here.
picker_offline_warning: You are offline. Catalog timetables are not listed until you are back online.
profile_delete_text: {name}, its timetable copies and its group selection are removed from this device. Other profiles keep theirs.
profile_description: Each profile is a saved variant of your timetable. Keep the ones you like.
profile_locked_hint: The profile is locked. Unlock it to change the selection.
profile_name_taken: A profile with this name already exists.
profile_rename_text: The name appears in the profile list, in downloaded file names and as the calendar name of the export.
share_warning_description: Your friend can't open these timetables from the link alone. Download them and send the files along with the link.
subject_catalog_warning: {timetable} comes from the catalog. Once you save a change, it no longer receives catalog updates.
subject_delete_text: {subject} is removed from {timetable}. This cannot be undone.
subject_dialog_text: Changes apply to {timetable} in this profile only.
subject_error_duplicate: This timetable already holds exactly this subject.
subject_error_group: Write the group as category.index, e.g. 2.1, or leave it empty.
subject_error_time: Every end has to come after its start.
toast_catalog_abbreviations_updated: Subject names updated from the catalog.
toast_catalog_dates_updated: Updated the global dates from the catalog.
toast_catalog_locations_updated: Room information updated from the catalog.
toast_ics_empty: Nothing to export in this period.
toast_ics_failed: Could not build the calendar file.
tree_catalog_current: Up to date with the catalog
tree_catalog_offline: Offline: catalog updates cannot be checked
tree_description: Try out different subject variations for this profile.
tree_empty: Groups appear here once the profile holds a timetable.
tree_remove_text: {name} and its group selection are removed from this profile. Other profiles keep their copy.
tree_rename_taken: This profile already holds a timetable with that name.
update_from_catalog: The catalog serves a new version of {file}.
update_none: This version is identical to yours.
upload_error_dates_shape: does not match the expected global dates format:
upload_error_shape: does not match the expected timetable format:
upload_error_storage: Your browser refused to save the profile; the change will be gone after a reload.
warn_multi_group_for_subject: More than one group selected for {subject}: {groups}.
warn_non_overlap: Selected groups do not overlap: {group} does not fit.
warn_sh_range: Date range unclear for SH1/SH2 subjects.
backup_error: This is no backup of this app, or it is damaged. Nothing was changed.
backup_restore_text: Profiles, dates and settings on this device are replaced by the backup. Profiles now: {current}, in the backup: {count}.
ios_hint: Add Zeiteisen to your home screen: Safari deletes the data of websites you have not opened for 7 days.
profile_duplicate_text: The copy gets every timetable and the whole group selection of this profile. It starts unlocked.
subject_on_demand_hint: Only takes place if enough students sign up.
import_missing_hint: Ask whoever sent you the link for the missing timetable files. They can download each one with the button next to the timetable's name.
